name: hud_ui_mgr_sensor_block_destructor
description: HudUiMgrSensorBlock::Destructor resets the sensor meter ftable and destructs the sensor overlay and panel widgets.
known_limits: tier S verification was not accepted in this session. Binary Ninja shows the retail body includes compiler-generated EH frame state around the member teardown sequence.

A local VC5SP3 compile-only manifest failed in MFC/GameNet provider headers before reaching this function; switching to the established VC5SP3 zhud_ui.cpp profile still failed on existing GameNet static-assert compatibility, so no VC object-byte comparison was attempted.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x40d6e0 reset sensorMeter.ftable to g_HudUiCommon_FTable, then call HudUiWidget::DestructorCore for sensorOverlay and sensorPanel.
HudUiWidget::DestructorCore is an accepted functionally equivalent dependency.
The native sensor-block destructor smoke verifies the sensor meter common-table reset and the overlay/panel common-table resets produced by DestructorCore.
